title: Odal Node — Electronics Product Group Data (v1.3.0)
description: ICT and electronics fields. v1.3.0 adds repairabilityIndexInputs, the six Annex IV point 5 parameters of Regulation (EU) 2023/1669 from which the enacted repairability index is computed, and indexScopeExclusion, which declares the Art. 1(a) rollable-display or Art. 1(b) high-security carve-out that no other field can express. Both are optional and neither is a passport obligation: Regulation (EU) 2023/1669 places the index on the energy label and in the product information sheet and does not mention a passport. Regulatory basis: Regulation (EU) 2023/1670 Art. 1(1) (ecodesign) and Regulation (EU) 2023/1669 (energy labelling), both applying from 20 June 2025. Applicability dates and regulatory status are held in the product group manifest, not here. v1.2.0 narrows productCategory to the four device types Art. 1(1) actually enumerates (smartphone, other mobile phone, cordless phone, slate tablet) — laptop/monitor/tv/server/router/charger/earphone/pcb/other carried no regulatory basis and are removed. v1.1.0 corrects repairabilityScore to the structured {overall, criteria} shape; v1.0.0 declared it as a bare number, which the Rust type never produced.

energyEfficiencyClass.description: EU energy label class (A = most efficient, G = least efficient).

co2ePerUnitKg.description: Whole-lifecycle carbon footprint in kg CO2e per unit.

repairabilityScore.description: Repairability score (non-regulatory heuristic, not EN 45554 / EU 2023/1669). overall is 0.0-10.0; >= 6.0 is considered good.

repairabilityIndexInputs.description: The six Annex IV point 5 parameters of Regulation (EU) 2023/1669 as the operator declares them, from which the enacted repairability index R is computed. Declared values, not a score. Annex IX Table 10 sets the verification tolerance for the resulting index: the determined value shall not be more than 4 % lower than the declared value. Only smartphones and slate tablets are in scope of that Regulation, and nothing obliges a passport to carry these.

disassemblyDepth.description: SDD - disassembly depth, scored per priority part from the number of steps: 2 steps or fewer scores 5, more than 15 scores 1.

tools.description: ST - tools: none 5, basic 4, supplied with the spare part 3, supplied with the product 2, commercially available 1.

softwareUpdates.description: SSU - operating-system update duration: 7 years or more scores 5, 6 years scores 3, 5 years scores 1.

indexScopeExclusion.description: A declaration that Art. 1(a) or Art. 1(b) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1669 carves this unit out of the repairability index's scope. Art. 1(a) is a flexible main display the user can unroll and roll up; Art. 1(b) is a smartphone for high security communication. Both are otherwise indistinguishable from an ordinary smartphone or slate tablet, which is why the exclusion has to be declared. Absent means not excluded, never unknown.

sparePartsAvailable.description: Whether spare parts are commercially available from the manufacturer.

repairManualUrl.description: URL to the repair manual or repair information portal.

disassemblyInstructionsUrl.description: URL to disassembly or dismantling instructions.

svhcSubstances.description: SVHC substances present above 0.1% w/w per REACH Article 33.

rohsCompliant.description: Whether the product complies with RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU.

criticalRawMaterials.description: Critical raw materials present per EU CRM Act 2024/1252.

recycledContentPct.description: Recycled content as a percentage of total product weight.

expectedLifetimeYears.description: Expected product lifetime in years under normal use.

firmwareUpdateUntil.description: Date until which firmware or software updates are guaranteed (ISO 8601).

priorityPartScores.description: The ten priority parts Annex IV point 5 names (BAT, DA, BC, FFC, RFC, EC, BUT, MIC, SPK, FM), each scored 1-5 by the rubric of the parameter being scored. Two rules the operator applies before declaring: a part occurring more than once takes the score of its lowest-scoring instance, and a part not present in the product takes the highest point level. foldingMechanism is absent for a non-foldable product, and its presence selects the foldable weight set, so it must be stated consistently across all three part-level parameters.

foldingMechanism.description: FM - hinge assembly or mechanical display folding mechanism. Absent for a non-foldable product.

$comment: NO PASSPORT OBLIGATION. An act binds this product group today, but no act requires a digital product passport for it — the duty is either absent from the instrument entirely or discharged through another system under ESPR Art. 9(4)(b). This schema therefore describes data we model, not a passport the law asks for. Structural validation against it is not evidence of compliance with any passport obligation, and no binding passport determination may be emitted here. Removing this marker takes an act that actually imposes a passport; no status change can do it.
